method.endpoint_reconstruction: B31 alerts provide source polygon and edge indices. For each non-crossing pair of original 2D segments, compute minimum among four endpoint-to-other-segment projections; replace B30 rounded endpoints by full-precision B16 closest-point geometry.
method.cross_section: Intersect the exact nearest-point connector against ALL boundary segments of its source B16 polygon, sort parameter t=0..1, sample midpoint of each open interval using even-odd point-in-polygon, merge consecutive same-medium intervals.
method.tolerance: Floating-point planar candidate coordinates. Parametric interior t>1e-8 and t<1-1e-8; deduplicate intersections by t at 1e-7; near-parallel determinant <1e-10. Collinear overlaps are recorded separately.
method.coastal_arc: For orientation only, compute the shorter of the two polygon-boundary arc lengths between closest segment positions. Arc/gap ratio is NOT a certified isthmus score.
limits: This screen examines ONLY B31's 56 original candidates, not a global search for all narrow isthmuses.
The candidate endpoint selection is limited by B31's 10-or-more-index separation rule, which is sensitive to the nonuniform vertex density.
Crossing fractions are drawing-space fractions on each short connector, not real-world sea/land area or width.
A connector spanning land does not prove a land bridge whose smallest width has been accurately measured.
The source polygons are not official planetary latitude/longitude or terrain/sea-level data.
